usageNotes: Use this to add a numbered entry (sequence) to an existing SDN route map, which controls BGP/EVPN prefix filtering and attribute modification in Proxmox SDN. The parent route map must already exist (create it first via the route-maps endpoint), and the caller requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/route-maps. After creating entries, apply the pending SDN configuration with the cluster SDN apply endpoint for changes to take effect.

examples.summary: Add a permit entry at order 10 to the 'mgmt-filter' route map, jumping to the next entry on match

tips: The 'order' field determines evaluation sequence; lower values are evaluated first. Leave gaps (e.g. 10, 20, 30) to allow future insertions without renumbering.
Use 'call' to invoke a secondary route map as a subroutine before the current entry's action is applied.
Use 'exit-action' with 'on-match-goto' and a target order index to implement non-sequential route map logic (policy-based jumps).
The 'digest' parameter should be passed from a prior GET of the route map to prevent overwriting concurrent edits.
The 'lock-token' is required when the global SDN configuration is locked for staged editing; omit it for direct single-operation writes.
Changes are pending until you POST to /cluster/sdn to apply the SDN configuration cluster-wide.
